create.responsibility: Define j_d=P^d j from the existing one-copy original source; define physical prime and integer translate histories and repeated forward translates. Prove support/regularity and d=0 equalities.
Identify actual transforms on their initial safe half-plane and prove analytic continuation/nonvanishing for the exact one-copy source; construct the original visible simple-pole datum.
Concrete generator definitions as actual local causal actions, their safe-domain transforms and unit factors. Inverse Euler filter is locally finite, not incorrectly global finite variation.
Instantiate the finite correction-aware law on actual native transformations, not a class defined by faithfulness.
Use existing HorizonSchedule, positiveRate and SubexpAlong. Prove norm-first comparison for real/complex Hilbert fields and allocation without assuming absolute energy error small.
Finite-dimensional joint contrast/history observation; exact cost including zero-map convention, extension, noise and incompatible data.
Cauchy coefficient estimates on a genuine common disk; apply to changing completion depth only with the full actual cost.
Uniform whole-plane product estimate using the prescribed infinite box convolution, then source derivative cost bounds.
Prove the moving-left-line zeta and derivative envelope using only valid functional equation, fixed-strip gamma and Cauchy estimates; include any needed library adapters here.
Actual inversion, horizontal contour control, uniform factorial envelope and saddle selection.
Prove actual finite J17 Dirichlet-convolution identity and divisor envelopes with coprimality palette and repeated products.
Prove logarithmic-slack decomposition with palette frozen per window and its full support-delay budget.
Bound both low-mask realizations at B(t)=exp(sqrt t), and apply norm-first transfer. This module has no Theta-equality assumption or conclusion.
Specialize the actual zeta explicit formula to translated compact j_d. Derive absolute zero/trivial sums and the multiplicity-weighted source upper, not an assumed rate.
Uniform in derivative source order: Gevrey L1/Linfty costs, drive L2, and Theta-dependent physical field envelope.
Construct actual c_k,a_k and the uniform beta/endpoint/Poisson estimates A4-A5 from Part II.
Arbitrary-multiplicity actual residual and monic shifted Laguerre normalization, including stable-input estimate and finite truncation only.
Full continuous fixed-source limit J5.2 using actual transforms and all uniform estimates; no bare nativeRate hypothesis.
Retain and formalize the optional-for-fixed-application MS1 as an explicit full-package coverage choice.

A genuine complex locally finite measure API compatible with P0 real Jordan pairs, compact restrictions, total variation, S-prime embedding, real/imaginary extraction and linear-growth estimates. Do not use globally finite SignedMeasure as a replacement.
Actual scaled combs D_t on the full integer lattice with linear variation and Fourier transport on Schwartz tests.
Noncompact absolute mixing class, real/complex measures, actual logarithmic Mobius inverse and leakage. Compact-support proof is not enough.
Near-sharp mass bounds, S-prime compactness/vanishing under a common variation budget, and actual nonmeasure normalized limit.
Subtract origin/continuum before integration, prove entire tempered family then local total-variation identification as the exact density-plus-atom measure.

Finite power-sum expansion with explicit endpoint convention and locally uniform parameter remainder, including differentiated finite sums. This is a foundation proof obligation, not an imported unverified formula.
Actual h=1-Srho/brho, reflection quotient kappa, tail, integer jumps, integrals and ordinary Fourier identity.

Define true log unitary x=exp(t), the frequency convention without 2pi, weak derivatives, H1/H-1 realization and justified dual pairings. Derive convention conversion to pinned Mathlib Fourier; no imaginary separate force transforms.
Derive distributional cell equation with every atomic derivative jump and distinguish form versus operator domain.
Native finite multi-zero integrals and samples, exact undivided compatibility, and forced finite-dimensional countercontrol.
Actual parameter jets up to multiplicity minus one; local inverse rho(kappa), reflection duplicates and realification proved.
Actual first-cell density to Hermite interpolation; normalized derivative coefficients and reflection quotient.
Instantiate the real signed separator only after all complex-jet realification and variation hypotheses are proved.
Quantitative first-cell density and required repair cost, with the height and delta conditions retained.
Actual nonlinear square, convolution Fourier defect, no tempered lattice-measure repair, gap filling under selfdual projection.
Define the tempered force from the derivative of integrable sawtooth before stating the compact-test lattice-minus-continuum equality.
Positive measure with finite weighted moment; do not impose finite unweighted total mass.
Identify actual zero profile with unique H1 forced log-resolvent and its actual sampling functional.
Generic nonzero parameter forced solution and plateau coefficient; never register the diagnostic equivalence as an independent zero-exclusion theorem.
Reproduce the finite/functional countercontrols with exact types and no claim they are actual off-line zeros.
